'''Akoru''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Beast-Lord]] of [[Onderon/Legends|Onderon]] who led the [[Untamed]] during the [[third Galactic War]]. He was brother to the [[Sith]] [[Brutann]].<ref name="Onslaught">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Onslaught]]''</ref> During Akoru's reign, he neglected the Untamed's control of the [[Proving Grounds|Ancient Proving Grounds]], allowing the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] noble families to take greater control of the site for use as a vacation retreat.<ref name="Codex">{{TORcite|exp=ons|type=codex|Ancient Proving Grounds}}</ref>
